QUOTE: "The 16-bit code is split by the layout comment in `include/mbedtls/error.h:17-90`: 3 high-level module bits in `0xFF80`, and 7 low-level module bits below that. A caller can therefore get either half alone or both joined, e.g. `-0x40A0` becomes `\"RSA - Bad input parameters to function : AES - Invalid key length\"`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains the code has high-level and low-level layers and that mbedtls_strerror joins both (" : ") when both are present.
